integrity: The proof is exact and analytic. Its only nontrivial external input is the published theorem identifying the complete set of minimising Fourier-zero directions of the regular dodecagon. The affine covariance and singular-value inequalities are derived explicitly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers determinant-one linear images only and does not settle the full planar maximisation problem.
The anisotropy cutoff is sharp for the twelve-nearest-zero witness method, not proved sharp for the true affine-orbit functional.
Targeted novelty searches cannot exclude an older equivalent affine-Fourier observation under different terminology.
title: A quantitative affine-orbit region for the regular dodecagon Fourier-zero problem
